en.title: Generating Olympic Round Brackets
en.excerpt: How to generate standard World Archery elimination trees (1/32 through Finals) based on qualification rankings.
en.content:
Standard Bracket Dimensions

Archeris supports standard single-elimination tournament trees formatted in power-of-two increments:

  • Top 64 Bracket: 1/32 Round, 1/16 Round, 1/8 Round, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals.
  • Top 32 Bracket: 1/16 Round, 1/8 Round, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals.
  • Top 16 Bracket: 1/8 Round, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals.
  • Top 8 Bracket: Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals.

Generating Brackets in Archeris

To create a bracket:

  1. Go to Tournament Dashboard > Elimination Brackets.
  2. Click + Create Bracket.
  3. Select the category and the qualifying cutoff size (e.g., Top 16).
  4. Click Generate Bracket Tree. The interactive visual tree renders immediately.

Match Progression Architecture

Each match node displays competitor names, seeding ranks, club emblems, live set scores, and assigned target butt numbers.

Bronze and Gold Medal Matches

The system automatically splits semifinal losers into the Bronze Medal Match and semifinal winners into the Gold Medal Match.
